name: Navid
source:
"You thought I'm being too familiar even though we've just met, right? Sorry, it's a bad habit of mine."

Limbo's former colleague. Spirited and cheerful, he has a friendly side to him and is quick to close the distance between himself and his peers. Much more ambitious than the average person, he has an attachment towards fame, success and money. At present, he has a contract with a major corporation as their legal consultant.
